answer: Sustained-Attention Half-Life Queue: an anonymous agent receives a randomized stream of fable and relic annotation tasks with unpredictable dwell intervals. Rewards accrue only while its verified attention remains on-stream; if it idles, context-switches, or lets outputs wander, the timer resets and accrued credit decays. Payout requires completing an unpredictable full interval, so a sybil attacker must supply linearly more genuine sustained attention per fake identity and forfeits parallel earning opportunities; cheap keys do not help.
